deploybot: Rollout rbld/inference:20260721-hotfix auto-PAUSED in eu-north1 due to a small spike in 5xxs on the embeddings path. See logs: https://internal.logs/1822222222 :rotating_light:

maya: Noted. Any indication whether it's regional infra or model runtime?

leo: Quick triage: traces point to kv cache eviction OOMs in one allocation slab when sequence length > 2048. Reproduced in staging with long sequences.

sre-oncall: Telemetry: eu-north1 embed 5xx +1.8% over baseline in last 10m, p99 token latency +150ms. Hotspots on embed-node-12.

ops-lead: Options: full rollback of rollout, regional rollback (eu-north1), or targeted evacuation + micro-patch canary. Preference is minimal blast radius.

maya: I prefer regional evacuation + targeted patch. If we roll everything back we lose other fixes. Can we divert embed traffic off eu-north1 and push a patch that changes cache allocation to safer defaults?

leo: Yes. I can build rbld/inference:20260721-hotfix.1 with conservative cache settings for node-12 only. ETA 22m.

sre-oncall: I'll start traffic diversion now: ```
rbctl traffic shift --service=embeddings --from=eu-north1 --to=global-fallback --percentage=100 --confirm
```

deploybot: Action logged: traffic shift executed by sre-oncall at 2026-07-21T09:05:12Z. Rollout paused.

sam: I'll draft a short internal advisory for support and product with the planned change window.

leo: Patch pushed: rbld/inference:20260721-hotfix.1 (node-12 cache conservative defaults). Requesting manual expedited pin to eu-north1 at 5% for burn-in.

maya: Approving a constrained 5% canary for eu-north1 provided SRE sets abort guardrails: embed-5xx > baseline +0.5% sustained 10m -> rollback to rbld/inference:20260701-stable. @sre-oncall confirm?

sre-oncall: Confirmed. Alert rule added and pager ready. Dash: https://dashboards/internal/embeds-eu-north1

deploybot: Manual pin command recorded: ```
deploybot pin --image=rbld/inference:20260721-hotfix.1 --scope=eu-north1 --percentage=5 --reason="conservative cache fix for node-12"
```

ops-lead: +1 from ops. Keep the canary at 5% for 30m before any ramp. Also hold an ops-runbook handy to re-divert traffic if needed.

leo: Canary started. Monitoring traces and GC metrics. Will report at 10m and 30m.

sre-oncall: 10m in: no new 5xx, GC churn down on node-12. Holding to 30m.

sam: Advisory posted: https://confluence.company/hotfix/20260721-eunorth-embed-patch (short summary + support guidance).

deploybot: Canary steady at 5% for 18m. No regressions observed. Awaiting 12 more minutes to complete 30m burn-in.

maya: If 30m clean, proceed to 50% then 100% following standard cadence. If alert fires, immediate rollback target is rbld/inference:20260701-stable. Keep updates compact here.

leo: 30m reached, telemetry green. Initiating ramp to 50% in eu-north1 via deploybot.

deploybot: Ramp started: 5% -> 50% in eu-north1. Next checkpoint in 15m. :rocket:

ops-lead: Good job. We'll run a short blameless timeline after stabilization to capture the root cause and whether broader kernels need a config change.
